func TestComponentRules(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name     string
		cell     string
		resource Resource
		want     string
	}{
		{name: "valid component kept", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "Instance", Name: "random",
			Tags: map[string]string{ComponentTag: "apps"}}, want: "apps"},
		{name: "invalid component ignored", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "Instance", Name: "gru-1-ctl-1",
			Tags: map[string]string{ComponentTag: "gru"}}, want: "controller"},
		{name: "dr source", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "Bucket", Name: "gru-1-dr-sfo-1-backup",
			Tags: map[string]string{drSourceTag: "sfo"}}, want: "disaster-recovery"},
		{name: "member host", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "Instance", Name: "gru-1-db-1-retired-20261006",
			Tags: map[string]string{resourceTag: "terrabase-host"}}, want: "terrabase"},
		{name: "member data volume", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "Volume", Name: "gru-1-member-1-data",
			Tags: map[string]string{resourceTag: "member-data"}}, want: "terrabase"},
		{name: "database role", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "Instance", Name: "random",
			Tags: map[string]string{roleTag: "db"}}, want: "terrabase"},
		{name: "managed volume", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "Volume", Name: "random",
			Tags: map[string]string{resourceTag: "managed-volume"}}, want: "apps"},
		{name: "terrascale app", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "Instance", Name: "random",
			Tags: map[string]string{appTag: "forgejo"}}, want: "apps"},
		{name: "node pool mark", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "Instance", Name: "random",
			Tags: map[string]string{poolTag: "pool-a"}}, want: "node-pool"},
		{name: "controller boot volume", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "BootVolume", Name: "ts-gru-2 (Boot Volume)"}, want: "controller"},
		{name: "controller backup", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "BootVolumeBackup", Name: "gru-1-ctl-1-pre-anna-20261007"}, want: "controller"},
		{name: "database name", cell: "gru", resource: Resource{Type: "Volume", Name: "gru-1-db-1-data"}, want: "terrabase"},

for _, c := range []struct {
		name, object, key string
		value             any
	}{
		{"other default backend", "listener", "default-backend-set-name", "ts-auth"},
		{"hostname restricted", "listener", "hostname-names", []any{"terrabase"}},
		{"path routing", "listener", "path-route-set-name", "plaintext"},
		{"routing policy", "listener", "routing-policy-name", "plaintext"},
		{"missing redirect binding", "listener", "rule-set-names", nil},
		{"additional rule binding", "listener", "rule-set-names", []any{"https-redirect", "0000000000V4MRM46HP1SNGDYW"}},
		{"missing rule", "rule-set", "items", nil},
		{"empty rules", "rule-set", "items", []any{}},
		{"other action", "redirect", "action", "ADD_HTTP_RESPONSE_HEADER"},
		{"temporary status", "redirect", "response-code", 302},
		{"default status", "redirect", "response-code", nil},
		{"missing conditions", "redirect", "conditions", nil},
		{"empty conditions", "redirect", "conditions", []any{}},
		{"additional condition", "redirect", "conditions", []any{
			map[string]any{"attribute-name": "PATH", "attribute-value": "/", "operator": "PREFIX_MATCH"},
			map[string]any{"attribute-name": "PATH", "attribute-value": "/readyz", "operator": "EXACT_MATCH"},
		}},
		{"narrow path", "condition", "attribute-value", "/readyz"},
		{"exact root only", "condition", "operator", "EXACT_MATCH"},
		{"other attribute", "condition", "attribute-name", "HOST"},
		{"plaintext destination", "destination", "protocol", "HTTP"},
		{"foreign host", "destination", "host", "other.terrascale.tech"},
		{"missing host", "destination", "host", nil},
		{"plaintext port", "destination", "port", 80},
		{"retained plaintext port", "destination", "port", nil},
		{"replaced path", "destination", "path", "/"},
		{"missing path", "destination", "path", nil},
		{"dropped query", "destination", "query", ""},
		{"missing query", "destination", "query", nil},
	} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			d, f, _, _, _ := reviewedEdge(t)
			set := field(f.balancer, "rule-sets", "https-redirect").(map[string]any)
			redirect := set["items"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)
			objects := map[string]map[string]any{
				"listener":    field(f.balancer, "listeners", "http").(map[string]any),
				"rule-set":    set,
				"redirect":    redirect,
				"condition":   redirect["conditions"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any),
				"destination": redirect["redirect-uri"].(map[string]any),
			}
			objects[c.object][c.key] = c.value
			want := "https-redirect rule set"
			if c.object == "listener" {
				want = "listener http"
			}
			if err := d.CheckBalancer(f.balancer); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
				t.Fatalf("accepted HTTP redirect drift %s: %v", c.name, err)
			}
		})
	}

i, remote, _ := setupIssuer(t)
	started := make(chan struct{})
	remote.mu.Lock()
	remote.blockToken = started
	remote.mu.Unlock()
	var mu sync.Mutex
	var cancelLease context.CancelFunc
	i.homeWrite = func(ctx context.Context) (context.Context, func(), error) {
		leased, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
		mu.Lock()
		cancelLease = cancel
		mu.Unlock()
		return leased, cancel, nil
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { _, err := i.Ensure(t.Context()); done <- err }()
	select {
	case <-started:
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("token request did not start")
	}
	mu.Lock()
	cancel := cancelLease
	mu.Unlock()
	cancel()
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		if err == nil {
			t.Fatal("lost home lease reported successful issuance")
		}
	case <-time.After(2 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("lost home lease did not cancel and join SDK token request")

func TestMemberStatusServicePrivilegeSeparation(t *testing.T) {
	if GuestServiceTimeoutSeconds >= GuestDeadlineSeconds {
		t.Fatal("guest service timeout must leave host shutdown fallback")
	}
	legacy := ServiceUnit("")
	templateContains(t, legacy, "TimeoutStartSec=270s")
	setup := ManagedVolumeSetupScript()
	for _, part := range []string{`ln -s ../vdb "$ALIAS"`, `mount -t ext4 -o rw "$ALIAS" "$MOUNT"`, "BLKID=/usr/sbin/blkid", `chmod 0700 "$MOUNT/data" "$MOUNT/replication"`} {
		templateContains(t, setup, part)
	}
	templateExcludes(t, setup, "replication/shard")
	unit := ManagedVolumeSetupUnit(ManagedVolumeUUID)
	templateContains(t, unit, "Environment=TS_FC_VOLUME_UUID=")
	templateContains(t, unit, "Before=ts-member-status-qualification.service")
	managed := ServiceUnit(ManagedVolumeUUID)
	for _, part := range []string{"Requires=ts-member-status-managed-volume-setup.service", "NoNewPrivileges=yes", "CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_CHOWN CAP_KILL CAP_SETUID CAP_SETGID CAP_SETPCAP CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH", "CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH"} {
		templateContains(t, managed, part)
	}
	templateExcludes(t, managed, "CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE")
	templateContains(t, legacy, "CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_CHOWN CAP_KILL CAP_SETUID CAP_SETGID CAP_SETPCAP")
	templateExcludes(t, legacy, "CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH")
	templateExcludes(t, legacy, "CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE")
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "setup.sh")
	script.Write(t, path, []byte(setup), 0600)
	checked := script.Exec(t, script.Root(t), nil, "/bin/sh", "-n", path)
	templateEqual(t, checked.Code, 0)
}

	saturatedLongEnough := Memory{SaturatedSince: map[string]time.Time{"gru": testNow.Add(-2 * time.Hour)}}
	idleLongEnough := Memory{IdleSince: map[string]time.Time{"sfo": testNow.Add(-IdleFor - time.Hour)}}

		regions    []Region
		candidates []Candidate
		memory     Memory
		headroom   uint64
		price      uint64
		action     string
		cell       string // the suggested cell
		reason     string // a substring of the written reason
	}{
		{name: "saturated region suggests the nearest candidate", regions: testRegions(statusSaturated(), statusBusy(), statusBusy()),
			candidates: lhrAndAms, memory: saturatedLongEnough, headroom: testHeadroom, price: testPrice,
			action: ActionAdd, cell: "ams", reason: "gru has wanted more nodes for 2h0m0s; ams is 120ms away, and 3 nodes cost BRL 270.00 a month; the budget has BRL 400.00 headroom"},
		{name: "saturation needs an hour", regions: testRegions(statusSaturated(), statusBusy(), statusBusy()),
			candidates: lhrOnly, memory: Memory{SaturatedSince: map[string]time.Time{"gru": testNow.Add(-30 * time.Minute)}},
			headroom: testHeadroom, price: testPrice, action: ActionNone, reason: "wanted more nodes since"},
		{name: "a region at its ceiling is needed to add", regions: testRegions(statusBusy(), statusBusy(), statusBusy()),
			candidates: lhrOnly, memory: saturatedLongEnough, headroom: testHeadroom, price: testPrice,
			action: ActionNone, reason: "every region is within its load band"},
		{name: "unmeasured candidates fall back to distance", regions: noMeasurement, candidates: lhrOnly,
			memory: saturatedLongEnough, headroom: testHeadroom, price: testPrice, action: ActionAdd, cell: "lhr",
			reason: "km away (no round trip measured)"},
		{name: "a candidate neither measured nor located holds", regions: testRegions(statusSaturated(), statusBusy(), statusBusy()),
			candidates: unmeasured, memory: saturatedLongEnough, headroom: testHeadroom, price: testPrice,
			action: ActionNone, reason: "no candidate region has a measured round trip or a location near gru"},
		{name: "unknown node price gives none", regions: testRegions(statusSaturated(), statusBusy(), statusBusy()),
			candidates: lhrOnly, memory: saturatedLongEnough, headroom: testHeadroom, price: 0,
			action: ActionNone, reason: "the node price is unknown"},
		{name: "idle region is suggested for removal", regions: testRegions(statusBusy(), statusBusy(), statusIdle()),
			memory: idleLongEnough, action: ActionRemove, cell: "sfo", reason: "sfo has been idle at 3 nodes"},
		{name: "never suggests removing below two serving regions", regions: testRegions(statusBusy(), nil, statusIdle())[1:],
			memory: idleLongEnough, action: ActionNone, reason: "only 2 regions serve and never fewer than 2"},
		{name: "idle needs IdleFor", regions: testRegions(statusBusy(), statusBusy(), statusIdle()),
			memory: Memory{IdleSince: map[string]time.Time{"sfo": testNow.Add(-IdleFor + time.Hour)}},
			action: ActionNone, reason: "every region is within its load band"},
		{name: "never suggests removing the home", regions: testRegions(statusIdle(), statusBusy(), statusBusy()),
			memory: Memory{IdleSince: map[string]time.Time{"gru": testNow.Add(-IdleFor - time.Hour)}},
			action: ActionNone, reason: "every region is within its load band"},
		{name: "a region homing a partition is never suggested for removal", regions: func() []Region {
			regions := testRegions(statusBusy(), statusBusy(), statusIdle())
			regions[2].HomesPartitions = true
			return regions
		}(), memory: idleLongEnough, action: ActionNone, reason: "every region is within its load band"},
	}
	for _, tt := range cases {

			if suggestion.Action != tt.action || suggestion.Cell != tt.cell && tt.cell != "" {
				t.Fatalf("suggestion = %+v, want action %s for %q", suggestion, tt.action, tt.cell)

			if !strings.Contains(suggestion.Reason, tt.reason) {

			}
			if suggestion.Reason == "" || !suggestion.At.Equal(testNow) {
				t.Fatalf("suggestion %+v has no reason or time", suggestion)
			}
			if suggestion.Action == ActionAdd && suggestion.OCIRegion == "" {
				t.Fatalf("add %+v names no OCI region", suggestion)

	t.Parallel()
	now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Minute)
	history := observability.NewHistory(observability.HistoryConfig{})
	labels := observability.L("member", "host")
	filesystem := observability.L("member", "host", "role", "boot", "path", "/", "device", "7")
	samples := []observability.Sample{
		{Metric: observability.HistHostReceivedAt, Labels: labels, Value: float64(now.UnixMilli())},

		{Metric: observability.HistHostMemoryTotal, Labels: labels, Value: 100},
		{Metric: observability.HistHostMemoryRatio, Labels: labels, Value: .1},
		{Metric: observability.HistHostFSSize, Labels: filesystem, Value: 100},
		{Metric: observability.HistHostFSUsed, Labels: filesystem, Value: 10},
	}
	history.Append(now, samples)
	resources := CollectResources(Node{Name: "host"}, history, now)
	summary := Summary{ObservedAt: now, Nodes: []Node{{Name: "host", Resources: resources}}}
	fillNodeCapacity(&summary)

	history.Append(now, samples)

	summary.ObservedAt, summary.Nodes[0].Resources = now, resources
	fillNodeCapacity(&summary)
	if resources.Incomplete || summary.Capacity.Partial {

}

func TestAFailedSeatHoldsTheGroupUntilTheRollback(t *testing.T) {
	store, _, fence := testStore(t)
	c := newCell(t)
	controller := c.controller(store, fence)
	c.release(2)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.backends["10.251.0.21:9465"] = Backend{Drained: true}
	c.now = c.now.Add(DefaultDrainGrace)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.state["gru-1-db-1"] = "failed"
	for range 5 {
		c.now = c.now.Add(time.Minute)
		c.tick(controller)
	}
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})

	c.release(3)
	c.state["gru-1-db-1"] = "failed"
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
	c.state["gru-1-db-1"] = "running"
	c.tick(controller)
	c.now = c.now.Add(DefaultSettle)
	c.tick(controller)
	// Its host reports it serving, but the load balancer has not found it
	// healthy yet: it stays drained.
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
	// Once it does, the seat settles and returns.
	c.backends["10.251.0.21:9465"] = Backend{Drained: true, Healthy: true}
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
	c.now = c.now.Add(DefaultSettle)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, nil, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
}

func TestSeatsRestartOneAtATimeBehindTheirDrain(t *testing.T) {
	store, _, fence := testStore(t)
	c := newCell(t)
	controller := c.controller(store, fence)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, nil, []string{})

	c.release(2)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, nil)
	if c.wakes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the drain woke the load balancer publisher %d times", c.wakes)
	}

	// The load balancer has not applied the drain yet.
	c.now = c.now.Add(time.Minute)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, nil)
	if c.wakes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("a tick that wrote nothing woke the publisher: %d", c.wakes)
	}
	// It applies it a minute late: in-flight requests get their grace from
	// then, not from the drain request.
	c.backends["10.251.0.21:9465"] = Backend{Drained: true, Healthy: true}
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, nil)
	c.now = c.now.Add(DefaultDrainGrace - time.Second)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, nil)
	c.now = c.now.Add(time.Second)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})

	// The restarted seat serves, but returns to rotation only after the
	// settle time; the other seat waits all along.
	c.state["gru-1-db-1"] = "starting"
	c.tick(controller)
	c.state["gru-1-db-1"] = "running"
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
	c.now = c.now.Add(DefaultSettle)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, nil, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})

	// gru-1-db-2 drains only once gru-1-db-1 serves on the load balancer.
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, nil, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
	c.backends["10.251.0.21:9465"] = Backend{Healthy: true}
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-2"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
	c.backends["10.251.0.22:9465"] = Backend{Drained: true, Healthy: true}
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-2"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
	c.now = c.now.Add(DefaultDrainGrace)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-2"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1", "gru-1-db-2"})
	c.state["gru-1-db-2"] = "running"
	c.tick(controller)
	c.now = c.now.Add(DefaultSettle)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, nil, []string{"gru-1-db-1", "gru-1-db-2"})
}

func TestOfflineVerifiedInputsInstalled(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	f := newOffline(t)
	r := f.run(nil, nil, nil)
	successful(t, r)
	equal(t, read(t, f.output), read(t, f.base))
	equal(t, read(t, f.kernelOutput), f.kernel)
	contains(t, r.Stdout, fmt.Sprintf("base guest kernel release=%s bytes=%d sha256=%s", offlineKernelRelease, len(f.kernel), digest(f.kernel)))
	equal(t, strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(f.eventText()), "\n"), []string{"release-binary-candidate", "qemu-check", "qemu-info", "guestfish-listen", "qemu-check", "guestfish-listen-ro"})
	args := strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(string(read(t, f.releaseArgs)), "\x00"), "\x00")
	equal(t, args[:2], []string{"release", "binary-candidate"})
	equal(t, flagValue(t, args, "--source-revision"), offlineSource)
	equal(t, flagValue(t, args, "--qualification"), f.qualification)
	equal(t, filepath.Base(flagValue(t, args, "--binary")), "terrascale-orchestrator")
	equal(t, slices.Contains(args, f.rootA), false)
	owner := []any{float64(0), float64(0)}
	for path, data := range map[string][]byte{"/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator": read(t, f.binary), verifierGuest: read(t, f.verifier), netbirdGuest: read(t, f.netbird), netbirdConfigGuest: read(t, f.netbirdConfig), kernelGuest: f.kernel, ociRuleGuest: read(t, filepath.Join(deployRoot(t), "deploy/udev/65-terrascale-oci-device-paths.rules"))} {
		contains(t, r.Stdout, "image readback sha256="+digest(data)+" guest_path="+path)
	}
	f.installed(bootstrapDir+"/trust-roots/001.pem", read(t, f.rootA), 0444, owner)
	f.installed(bootstrapDir+"/trust-roots/002.pem", read(t, f.rootB), 0444, owner)
	for path, source := range map[string]string{verifierGuest: f.verifier, netbirdGuest: f.netbird, "/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator": f.binary, priorityHelperGuest: f.binary} {
		f.installed(path, read(t, source), 0755, owner)
	}
	f.installed("/usr/local/lib/terrascale-orchestrator/netbird-client", read(t, f.netbird), 0755, owner)
	bakedPin := object(t, read(t, f.path("/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/netbird-pin.json")))
	inputs := object(t, read(t, filepath.Join(f.repo, "deploy/image/image-inputs.json")))
	equal(t, bakedPin, inputs["netbird"])
	f.installed(netbirdConfigGuest, read(t, f.netbirdConfig), 0644, owner)
	f.installed(timeWaitDropin, []byte("[Service]\nTimeoutStartSec=300s\n"), 0644, owner)
	f.installed(ociRuleGuest, read(t, filepath.Join(deployRoot(t), "deploy/udev/65-terrascale-oci-device-paths.rules")), 0644, owner)
	normalized := []byte("[Time]\nNTP=\nNTP=ntp.deployment.example\nFallbackNTP=\nPollIntervalMinSec=32\nPollIntervalMaxSec=64\n")
	f.installed(timesyncGuest, normalized, 0644, owner)
	contains(t, r.Stdout, digest(normalized))
	profile := []byte(`{"version":1,"profile_id":"preview-1ocpu-6gib-v1","system_reserve_bytes":1073741824}`)
	f.installed(priorityProfileGuest, profile, 0644, owner)
	for i, path := range priorityDropins {
		content := string(read(t, f.path(path)))
		section, min, low := "[Service]", 64<<20, 128<<20
		if i == 0 {
			section, min, low = "[Slice]", 128<<20, 256<<20
		}
		contains(t, content, section)
		contains(t, content, fmt.Sprintf("MemoryMin=%d\n", min))
		contains(t, content, fmt.Sprintf("MemoryLow=%d\n", low))
		contains(t, r.Stdout, digest([]byte(content)))
	}
	metadata := object(t, read(t, f.metadata))
	for _, path := range []string{secretsDir, controllerDir} {
		equal(t, metadata[path], []any{float64(999), float64(999)})
		equal(t, mode(t, f.path(path)), os.FileMode(0700))
	}
	equal(t, metadata[markerDir], owner)
	equal(t, metadata["/var/lib/netbird"], owner)
	equal(t, mode(t, f.path("/var/lib/netbird")), os.FileMode(0700))
	contains(t, string(read(t, f.path("/etc/passwd"))), "terrascale-workload:x:2000:2000:")
	contains(t, string(read(t, f.path("/etc/group"))), "terrascale-workload:x:2000:")
	contains(t, string(read(t, f.path("/etc/passwd"))), "terrascale-orchestrator:x:999:999:")
	for _, name := range []string{"systemd-timesyncd.service", "systemd-time-wait-sync.service"} {
		symlink(t, f.path("/etc/systemd/system/sysinit.target.wants/"+name))
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"terrascale-orchestrator-controller.service", "terrascale-orchestrator-host.service", "netbird.service", "terrascale-netbird-enroll.service", "terrascale-netbird-agent.service"} {
		symlink(t, f.path("/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/"+name))
	}
	for _, link := range []string{"sockets.target.wants/ssh.socket", "ssh.service.requires/ssh.socket"} {
		symlink(t, f.path("/etc/systemd/system/"+link))
	}
	absent(t, f.path("/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap.service"))
	equal(t, bytes.Contains(read(t, filepath.Join(deployRoot(t), "deploy/image/build-offline.sh")), []byte("--run-command")), false)
	absent(t, f.path(filepath.Base(f.qualification)))
}

	f := newPromotion(t)
	successful(t, f.promote(nil, nil, f.realArgs()...))
	equal(t, f.commands(), []string{"verify-binary", "verify-image-production", "image-candidate", "sign-image", "verify-image"})
	calls := f.calls()
	equal(t, flagValue(t, calls[2], "--image-ocid"), importedOCID)
	equal(t, flagValue(t, calls[2], "--base-image-ocid"), "ocid1.image.oc1.sa-saopaulo-1.base")

		equal(t, flagValue(t, call, "--delegation"), filepath.Join(f.trust, "image-delegation.json"))
	}
	for _, call := range [][]string{calls[0], calls[2]} {
		equal(t, flagValue(t, call, "--delegation"), filepath.Join(f.trust, "delegation.json"))
	}
	f.imported(1)
	r := f.receipt()
	equal(t, r["dry_run"], false)

	equal(t, image["provenance"].(map[string]any)["workflow_run_head_sha"], strings.Repeat("b", 40))

	equal(t, r["tools"].(map[string]any)["gh"].(map[string]any)["sha256"], digest(read(t, f.gh)))
	equal(t, r["outcome"], "promotion complete")
}

func TestPromotionFirstRunWaitsForImageDelegation(t *testing.T) {
	f := newPromotion(t)
	r := f.promote(nil, nil, f.importArgs()...)
	successful(t, r)
	equal(t, f.commands(), []string{"verify-binary", "verify-image-production", "image-candidate"})
	contains(t, r.Stdout, "--image-ocid "+importedOCID)
	receipt := f.receipt()
	equal(t, receipt["image_receipt"], map[string]any{"awaiting": "root-signed image delegation", "image_ocid": importedOCID})
	equal(t, receipt["outcome"], "imported "+importedOCID+"; awaiting the root-signed image delegation")
	f.imported(1)
	f.reset()
	successful(t, f.promote(nil, nil, f.realArgs()...))
	equal(t, f.commands(), []string{"verify-binary", "verify-image-production", "image-candidate", "sign-image", "verify-image"})
	equal(t, f.receipt()["outcome"], "promotion complete")
	// The rerun found the live image by display name rather than importing twice.
	f.imported(1)
	equal(t, f.receipt()["oci_import"].(map[string]any)["image_id"], importedOCID)
}

func TestManagedMemberManifestSecurityMatrix(t *testing.T) {
	base := mmManifest(t)
	check := func(t *testing.T, name string, patchDirs bool) {
		t.Helper()
		f := base.clone(t)
		member := mmMap(mmMap(f.manifest["members"])["a"])
		config := mmMap(member["guest_config"])
		runtime := mmMap(config["runtime"])
		credential := mmMap(runtime["live_s3_credential"])
		scope := mmMap(mmMap(config["member"])["scope"])
		want := "runtime pins"
		switch name {
		case "wrong_peer":
			b := mmMap(mmMap(mmMap(f.manifest["members"])["b"])["guest_config"])
			mmMap(b["runtime"])["replication_peer_member_id"] = mmID("b")
		case "s3_config_hash":
			runtime["live_s3_config_sha256"] = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
		case "s3_target_hash":
			runtime["live_s3_target_sha256"] = strings.Repeat("0", 64)
		case "credential_version_2":
			credential["version_number"] = 2
			want = "S3 credential reference"
		case "credential_version_bool":
			credential["version_number"] = true
			want = "S3 credential reference"
		case "credential_version_float":
			credential["version_number"] = jsontext.Value(`1.0`)
			want = "S3 credential reference"
		case "credential_ocid":
			credential["secret_ocid"] = mmSecret + "-other"
			want = "S3 credential reference"
		case "shard_zero":
			scope["shard_id"] = 0
			want = "scope"
		case "shard_bool":
			scope["shard_id"] = true
			want = "scope"
		case "shard_negative":
			scope["shard_id"] = -1
			want = "scope"
		case "shard_overflow":
			scope["shard_id"] = jsontext.Value(`18446744073709551616`)
			want = "scope"
		case "lowercase_tenant":
			scope["tenant_id"] = strings.ToLower(scope["tenant_id"].(string))
			want = "scope"
		case "runtime_directory":
			want = "runtime directory"
		case "s3_endpoint", "s3_region":
			record := mmMap(mmMap(member["inputs"])["signed_v2_s3_config"])
			s3 := mmObject{"version": 1, "ack_profile": "object_durable", "bucket": "tbmm-" + strings.Repeat("2", 32), "region": mmRegion, "endpoint": mmEndpoint}
			if name == "s3_endpoint" {
				s3["endpoint"] = "http://rustfs.terrabase.test:9000"
			} else {
				s3["region"] = "us-east-1"
			}
			payload := mmJSON(t, s3)
			record["path"] = filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "a-signed-v2-s3-config.json")
			script.Write(t, record["path"].(string), payload, 0o600)
			record["sha256"] = mmSHA(payload)
			runtime["live_s3_config_sha256"] = record["sha256"]
			want = "signed S3 target"
		}
		_, e := f.load(t, patchDirs)
		if name == "valid" {
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
		} else {
			mmReject(t, e, want)
		}
	}
	// The production runtime directories must reject the fixture's scope.
	t.Run("runtime_directory", func(t *testing.T) { check(t, "runtime_directory", false) })
	t.Run("pinned", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Cleanup(mmPatchDirs(base.dirs))
		for _, name := range []string{"valid", "wrong_peer", "s3_config_hash", "s3_target_hash", "credential_version_2", "credential_version_bool", "credential_version_float", "credential_ocid", "s3_endpoint", "s3_region", "shard_zero", "shard_bool", "shard_negative", "shard_overflow", "lowercase_tenant"} {
			t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
				t.Parallel()
				check(t, name, false)
			})
		}
	})
}

}
